apps.web: Next.js public SEO/AEO site + authenticated web workspace/PWA shell where appropriate
apps.mobile: Expo Router React Native app for iOS/Android

packages.supabase: generated DB types, clients and query modules
packages.cost_engine: regional cost assumptions and deterministic calculators

services: scheduled/queued jobs through appropriate backend infrastructure
principles: One canonical data model for web/mobile
RLS enabled on all user/org/project scoped data
Publishable client key only in client apps; secret/server keys never shipped to Expo or browser
Server/admin operations use protected server environments
Provider webhooks are verified and idempotent
Files carry ownership, project, classification and rights metadata
Materialized/public read models for high-traffic directory/SEO surfaces

mobile_native: mobile wallet donation flows where supported

pwa_requirements: Offline-safe project drafts and field checklists
Share targets where browser support allows
Push only where supported and permissioned
No assumption PWA feature parity equals native feature parity
expo_requirements: Deep links aligned with public mosque.build URLs
Background sync only where platform rules and implementation support it
